evidence_text: New customers who have not held a personal savings account with us during the previous 12 months may qualify for a $150 account-opening bonus.
claim_statement: Customers who already held a personal savings account with the bank during the previous 12 months are eligible for the $150 bonus.
source_page_text: New customers who have not held a personal savings account with us during the previous 12 months may qualify for a $150 account-opening bonus. Open an eligible account by June 30, deposit at least $10,000 in new funds within 20 days of opening, and maintain that balance for 60 consecutive days. The bonus will be credited within 30 days after all requirements are met.
judgment_explanation: The offer is limited to new customers who have not held a personal savings account with the bank during the previous 12 months, so the claim about those existing customers is contradicted.
